description:
One post-call field the judge fills from the finished conversation (V5-30, P §4.2 C23).

Results land in ``session_qa.raw["fields"]`` as ``{name: value}``; a value
the conversation does not state is ``null``. ``select`` takes exactly one of
``options``; the other types take no ``options``.

description.description: What the field means, in words the judge reads (e.g. 'the kind of claim the caller reports').
description.title: Description

name.description: Lowercase identifier (letters, digits, underscores); the JSON key and CSV column.
name.title: Name

options.description: The choices of a `select` field (one is picked); empty for the other types.
options.title: Options

title: QaField
